description: Run one or more SQL statements against Snowflake as a Dagster asset -- mirrors Airflow's SnowflakeOperator / SQLExecuteQueryOperator.

sql.description: SQL text. May contain multiple ;-separated statements -- executed via Snowflake's real num_statements mechanism, not naive string splitting. Set exactly one of sql / sql_file / sql_statements.
sql.label: Sql

sql_statements.label: Sql Statements
sql_statements.description: Explicit list of statements, each run as its own cursor.execute() call -- no splitting ambiguity. Set exactly one of sql / sql_file / sql_statements.

account_env_var.description: Env var with Snowflake account. Required unless resource_key is set.
account_env_var.label: Account Env Var

user_env_var.description: Env var with Snowflake username. Required unless resource_key is set.
user_env_var.label: User Env Var

sql_file.label: Sql File
sql_file.description: Path (relative to the Dagster process working directory) to a .sql file, read and treated the same as `sql`. Set exactly one of sql / sql_file / sql_statements.

parameters.label: Parameters
parameters.description: Bind parameters applied to every statement (cursor.execute(stmt, parameters)), pyformat style (e.g. a statement containing %(my_param)s).

session_warehouse.label: Session Warehouse
session_warehouse.description: If set, runs 'USE WAREHOUSE <value>' before the main SQL -- a per-run override, distinct from warehouse_env_var (used when first connecting).

session_database.label: Session Database
session_database.description: If set, runs 'USE DATABASE <value>' before the main SQL.

session_schema.label: Session Schema
session_schema.description: If set, runs 'USE SCHEMA <value>' before the main SQL.

session_role.label: Session Role
session_role.description: If set, runs 'USE ROLE <value>' before the main SQL.

private_key_path_env_var.label: Private Key Path Env Var
private_key_path_env_var.description: Env var with RSA private key path.

warehouse_env_var.label: Warehouse Env Var
warehouse_env_var.description: Env var with Snowflake warehouse (used when first connecting).

role_env_var.label: Role Env Var
role_env_var.description: Env var with Snowflake role (used when first connecting).

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Optional key of a registered SnowflakeResourceComponent (resources/snowflake_resource). When set, connection credentials are read from that resource at run time instead of the inline account_env_var/user_env_var/password_env_var/pat_env_var/private_key_path_env_var/warehouse_env_var/role_env_var fields -- lets one credential serve this component and other components without configuring it twice.

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

pool.label: Pool
pool.description: Dagster's native named concurrency pool (e.g. Airflow's `pool` -- a fixed number of slots shared across every asset/op using the same pool name, e.g. warehouse concurrency limits). The pool's own slot count is configured at the deployment level (dagster.yaml's concurrency: pools:, or the Dagster+ UI), not here.

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Kill the wait and fail the run if the SQL hasn't finished after this many seconds. Enforced via a background-thread wrapper -- the underlying Snowflake call may continue running past the deadline (Python threads can't be forcibly killed, and this does not cancel the query server-side); this bounds the step's wait, not the call itself.
